critical_flags: A: thousands of tonnes of PCM introduce cycling, encapsulation, replacement, and heat-transfer risks while full mechanical backup remains necessary
B: limited trim capacity may not preserve its stated full-load objective through an unusually prolonged heat event
rationale: B wins the simpler-substitute test by replacing speculative bulk PCM with inspectable stratified water and retaining only limited mechanical trim. Its pilot gates and resource ledger are more operationally useful, although full-load extreme-event capacity still needs vendor-curve validation.
